pages.text: Water turns lava into obsidian. Arrival in the End rebuilds its platform, and a dragon’s revival rebuilds the pillars.$(br2)Three different paths form the same material. Any one can shape the mimic.

pages.title: Cooling Lava
pages.text: Use a sample at the center of a blank mimic, with these materials around it:$(br2)Water Bucket ×2$(br)Lava Bucket$(br)Rune Plate: Material Manifestation$(br)Rune Plate: Recognizing Conditions

pages.title: The Returning Pillars
pages.text: Use a sample at the center of a blank mimic, with these materials around it:$(br2)End Crystal ×4$(br)Rune Plate: Repetition and Sustain$(br)Rune Plate: Areas of Effect$(br)Rune Plate: Material Manifestation

pages.title: The End Platform
pages.text: Use a sample at the center of a blank mimic, with these materials around it:$(br2)Eye of Ender$(br)Obsidian$(br)Rune Plate: Spatial Transfer$(br)Rune Plate: Interdimensional Attunement$(br)Rune Plate: Material Manifestation$(br)Rune Plate: Areas of Effect
